nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the most recent lottery winner.
Public address state variable holding the contract owner, set in the constructor.
Public uint256 state variable accumulating the pot via msg.value.
Public uint256 state variable defining the number of players required to trigger a draw.
Public uint256 counter of finished lottery rounds, incremented without SafeMath.
Public address array of participants; pushed on deposit and deleted each round.
Constructor: assigns owner from msg.sender and initializes MaxPlayers to 10.
Owner-restricted setter for MaxPlayers with range validation 3 <= num < 1000.
Payable fallback: requires msg.value >= .01 ether, records sender, grows jackpot, may call RandomWinner.
View getter returning the players array.
Private view randomness helper using block.difficulty, now, msg.sender and players as seed.
Private draw logic: picks winner with random()%players.length, pays winner and owner, resets state.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, player registration and randomness seed.
now (block.timestamp) used as part of the randomness seed in random().
External value transfer to the winner address chosen from the players array, executed before state reset.
External value transfer of the fee to the owner address, executed after the winner transfer.
Unchecked arithmetic jackpot += msg.value performed without SafeMath.
Unchecked arithmetic completedGames++ performed without SafeMath.
Manipulation of the players dynamic array via push(msg.sender) inside the payable fallback.
Assignment of MaxPlayers from the num parameter guarded only by the owner check.
uint256 parameter of UpdateNumPlayers used to update MaxPlayers.
Local uint256 in RandomWinner computed as balance/100 via SafeMath.div.

edges.reason: Constructor writes owner = msg.sender, granting privileged role to the deployer.
Constructor body assigns the owner state variable, establishing the access-control anchor.
Constructor initializes MaxPlayers to 10.
UpdateNumPlayers compares owner against msg.sender to authorize the caller.
Function UpdateNumPlayers consumes the num parameter.
The num parameter flows into the privileged MaxPlayers assignment operation.
UpdateNumPlayers writes the untrusted num value into MaxPlayers after the owner check.
Fallback executes players.push(msg.sender) for each deposit.
msg.sender is pushed into the players array, making attacker-controlled addresses participants.
Fallback performs jackpot += msg.value without overflow protection.
jackpot state variable is updated by unchecked addition of msg.value.
Fallback push mutates the players state array, growing it without bound.
Fallback transfers control to RandomWinner once players.length >= MaxPlayers.
RandomWinner reads players to determine its length and the winning index.
RandomWinner invokes random() to compute the winner index.
The players array is embedded in the randomness seed, so seed depends on attacker-controlled pushes.
block.timestamp (now) is used in the randomness seed, creating timestamp/manipulable randomness dependency.
msg.sender is part of the randomness seed, letting the caller influence the winner selection.
The pseudo-random value returns to RandomWinner for modulo indexing.
RandomWinner assigns lastWinner = players[random() % players.length].
RandomWinner performs an external value transfer to the winner before resetting contract state.
lastWinner is the destination of the external transfer; recipient is selected from attacker-joinable players.
The players array determines the recipient of the external transfer, allowing a malicious participant to receive and reenter.
A second external value transfer to owner occurs while state has not yet been fully reset.
owner address is the destination of the fee transfer.
The local fee amount is forwarded to the owner via transfer.
RandomWinner computes the local fee with SafeMath.div(address(this).balance, 100).
Contract balance derived from jackpot contributions is used in the fee arithmetic.
RandomWinner increments completedGames without overflow protection.
completedGames state variable is modified by the unchecked increment.
jackpot is reset to 0 only after the external transfers, allowing stale state during a reentrant call.
players array is deleted only after the external transfers, enabling reentrancy-based state manipulation.
getPlayers returns the players array state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter num of UpdateNumPlayers is a transient value whose only purpose is to feed the MaxPlayers assignment performed by the enclosing restricted function; merge into UpdateNumPlayers.
The local variable fee exists only inside RandomWinner as an intermediate result of the balance division used by the owner transfer; merge into RandomWinner.
